BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning contracts for materials or work required by joint operating agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to contracts for materials or work required by joint operating agencies; and amending RCW 43.52.560.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 43.52.560 and 2015 c 73 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Contracts for materials or work required—Sealed bids.
BillSection.P: Except as provided otherwise in this chapter, a joint operating agency shall purchase any item or items of materials, equipment, or supplies, the estimated cost of which is more than fifteen thousand dollars exclusive of sales tax, or order work for construction of generating projects and associated facilities, the estimated cost of which is more than twenty-five thousand dollars exclusive of sales tax, by contract in accordance with with the same authority, and subject to the same conditions, as is applicable to public utility districts under RCW 54.04.070 and 54.04.080, which require sealed bids for contracts.
